name: WendyQuest Run
hook: Grind a 15-hour pixel RPG dungeon just to win a single spicy nugget combo
tagline: Battle greased-up goblin fry cooks as your pixelated party hacks through infinite dungeons of deep-fried loot. Cash out to redeem your dripping cardboard voucher bag before the kitchen closes. If it crashes, the dungeon server resets and drops a soggy ice cream coupon instead.
